claim.claim-text: 1. A method (300) comprising, at a mobile device (102):

the method (300) further comprising: in response to a determination that said one or more sensed indicators (224) does not match said one or more stored patterns or models of behavior (228) previously associated with at least said first state, establishing and learning said previously unknown state based, at least in part, on said one or more sensed indicators (224).

2. The method (300) as recited in Claim 1, wherein establishing and learning said previously unknown state further comprises: identifying said current inferable user behavior context for said user with regard to said second state.
3. The method (300) as recited in Claim 1, wherein said current inferable user behavior context is based, at least in part, on one or more points of interest (140).
4. The method (300) as recited in Claim 1, wherein said current inferable user behavior context is based, at least in part, on one or more user activities.
5. The method (300) as recited in Claim 1, wherein said current inferable user behavior context is based, at least in part, on one or more time periods.

6. The method (300) as recited in Claim 1, wherein at least one of said one or more sensed indicators (224) is based, at least in part, on one or more wireless signals received from one other device (110) via one or more network interfaces (114) of said mobile device (102).

7. The method (300) as recited in Claim 6, wherein said determining (304) whether said dynamic user profile (220) is to transition from said first state to said second state comprises a determination that said other device is within a threshold distance of the mobile device.

8. The method (300) as recited in Claim 1, wherein at least one of said one or more sensed indicators (224) is based, at least in part, on either or both of: one or more sensed inertial movements (230) of said mobile device (102) from one or more inertial sensors (120) of said mobile device (102), or one or more sensed environmental measurements (232) from one or more environmental sensors (122).

9. The method (300) as recited in Claim 1, wherein at least one of said one or more sensed indicators (224) is based, at least in part, on either or both of: one or more encoded audio signals (234) recorded using a microphone (122-3) of said mobile device (102), or one or more encoded images (236) recorded using a light sensitive environmental sensor (122-2) of said mobile device (102).

10. The method (300) as recited in Claim 1, wherein at least one of said one or more sensed indicators (224) is based, at least in part, on a current estimated position location of said mobile device (102).

11. The method (300) as recited in Claim 1, wherein at least one of said one or more sensed indicators (224) is based, at least in part, on either or both of: an estimated future destination of said mobile device (102), or an estimated route of travel of said mobile device (102).

12. The method (300) as recited in Claim 1, wherein at least one of said one or more sensed indicators (224) is based, at least in part, on either or both of: one or more user schedule files accessible via said mobile device (102), or one or more user communication files accessible via said mobile device (102).

13. The method (300) as recited in Claim 1, wherein said one or more functions (118) performed, at least in part, by said mobile device (102) comprises at least one of: one or more location based service functions, one or more position location functions, one or more navigation functions, one or more network communication functions, or one or more user output functions.
14. An apparatus for use in a mobile device (102), the apparatus comprising:

15. An article comprising: a non-transitory computer-readable medium (250) having stored therein computer-readable instructions (252) executable by one or more processing units in a mobile device (102) to perform a method according to one of claims 1 to 13.
